correctness.rationale: For each dimension d=4,5,6, the source derives all third-vertex Hamming-distance separator sets for every even-distance pair and proves odd-distance pairs automatically satisfied. Translating a putative <=5 resolving set to a 5-set containing 0 is justified by XOR automorphisms and monotonicity; complete loops enumerate exactly 1365, 31465 and 595665 such sets, with zero valid. The exhibited six-sets pass every 56/240/992 even-distance pair. The four-cube complete 8008-subset enumeration yields 1600 valid six-sets; all 11 orbits are generated by the full 384-element automorphism group, disjoint, valid, and exhaustive. The provided exact C++17 certificate was compiled and run successfully. Domain is only the three finite cubes; no infinite extrapolation.

value.rationale: Hedetniemi–Laskar–Mulder explicitly asked for total metric dimension of Q_n for n>=4. Solving three consecutive first open dimensions is a natural finite cutoff, not an arbitrary small graph table; equal six-point minima for dimensions four through six exhibit a nontrivial plateau relative to ordinary metric dimensions. The first open cube additionally receives a complete 1600-base census and 11 automorphism-orbit classification, providing precise extremizer structure. An exact finite complete result can have independent value without a general formula for n>=7.
